[[File:Southern_Ocean.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''Southern Star'' traveling through the Southern Ocean]]
The '''Southern Ocean''' was a large body of water on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was situated south of the two main continents of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]] and [[Alanciar]]. The large frozen continent of [[Eshkrene]] at the planet's South Pole was situated south of the ocean. Under the [[Hilts Restoration]], large wooden sailing ships including the ''[[Southern Star]]'' used to explore the Southern Ocean. [[Uvak]]s were also known to be capable of flying for long distances over the Southern Ocean.
